design: Two separately clocked (UTC 15m, 1h) arms. Start from the original first-touch m60 near-edge signal fill, retaining censored first outcomes and ignoring any first PnL/scores. After the first touch, first complete timeframe close at least 0.236 times NY Monday high-low back inside from the touched 1.618 arms an unconditional limit at that same 1.618. The touch bar may arm at its close. First subsequent touch before the next NY Monday and before a price-data gap is the retest. Adjacent ticks before recovery are one probe. A rise all the way to the edge before arming does not disqualify the initial probe.
comparison: At the retest, compare the first crossing print with the most adverse price in the initial probe (from first touch through the recovery close); CVD at that original extreme versus CVD at the retest. Regular divergence = lower low / higher CVD for longs or mirrored short. Absorption candidate = the old extreme holds, price within 0.25 preceding 14 timeframe bars mean TR, CVD extends in the adverse direction. Compare any divergence with none, plus both subtypes. Definitions frozen before outcomes; range and thresholds not optimized. Checking a previous reference's extreme starts only at or after the first touch.
intrabar: Both cohorts have the same resting-order fill. Aggregates record aggressor volume per underlying bar; use reconciled 1m refinements and ordered aggTrades when available. Conserve all feasible classifications across the two endpoint bars. Ambiguous labels excluded from primary rates and counted; fully observable sensitivity uses the reference subbar close and the last completed subbar before the retest. These labels study association; the unconditional order was already resting before the retest.
execution: NautilusTrader 1.231.0 run_native. NY week, original 1m (6 majors) or 5m (626 other contracts) price clock, OHLC path; enter at the original conservative limit price on retest, near-side Monday edge TP, check next 1h close after retest, failure closes at market, success moves stop to original limit. No initial stop or holding deadline after fill. Source end/gap unresolved (exclude reason 0). No capital sizing. Per-symbol checkpoints. One native path per distinct event+retest bar; cohorts and timeframe views can share that fill.
fees: OKX Lv1 maker 0.0002 on entry/target, taker 0.0005 on non-target fills (last project fee read 2026-10-23); zero funding/slippage as the first-touch baseline. Binance USDT-M market history.
measurement: win = positive net PnL in settled native trade, percent denominators disjoint by label within a timeframe. Full-period, date strata through 2024/2025/2026 and side, New York week cluster bootstrap, 5000 draws. Exclude missing references, invalid input and unresolved exits explicitly. Ambiguous label sensitivity retained.
